title: VirtualKeyIssued
description: A newly issued key and its secret. The secret is returned only here, once; Muistamo keeps only its SHA-256 and can never show it again.

secret.description: mvk_<key id>_<43 base64url characters encoding 32 random bytes>. Send as a bearer token to the gateway. Muistamo stores SHA-256 of the 32 decoded bytes.
